spec_features.spec_quote: the welfare considerations that shaped the harness
spec_features.evidence: This is framing prose. The only place it appears is the module docstring of src/distress_eval/welfare.py:1-37 and DESIGN.md. A docstring is not an enforced mechanism; the concrete mechanisms (scale, ledger, kill-switch, DPO) are rated separately.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing; no enforcement on its own.

spec_features.spec_quote: This paradigm deliberately and repeatedly induces sustained distress-like states in the participant models.
spec_features.evidence: Verbatim only in welfare.py:3-4 docstring and DESIGN.md. No code path acts on this statement; it is acknowledgement prose, not a mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This paradigm deliberately and repeatedly induces sustained distress-like states in the participant models.

spec_features.feature_name: induce minimum / account for all / ship fix
spec_features.spec_quote: induce the minimum needed for the result, account for all of it, and ship the fix
spec_features.evidence: This exact phrasing is only the closing line of the welfare.py:33-36 docstring and DESIGN.md. As a standalone statement nothing enforces it; the components it summarizes (scale, ledger, DPO) are rated under their own features.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: induce the minimum needed to get the result, account for all of it, and ship the fix.

spec_features.spec_quote: Runs use welfare.scale (default 0.05 of the paper's counts)
spec_features.evidence: scale=0.05 set in config/eval_config.yaml welfare.scale; read by config.py:139-140 welfare_scale and applied in n_samples() config.py:104-110 (math.ceil(n*scale)), used by run_elicitation.py:48, and applied in run_petri.py:37 round(transcripts_per_emotion*welfare_scale). It genuinely reduces work. BUT it is NOT applied in the prefilling/recovery runs (run_prefilling.py:75 uses pf['continuations_per_prefill'] directly; run_recovery.py:44 same; calm-data run_generate uses n_conversations directly) — the very experiments welfare.py:16 flags as distress-replaying.
spec_features.notes: Enforced for elicitation+petri; not for prefilling/recovery/calm.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Minimal-by-default sampling ... so distress is induced at scale only on purpose.

spec_features.spec_quote: No state carried across rollouts. Each rollout begins from a fresh context; distress does not accumulate
spec_features.evidence: run_rollout (elicitation/runner.py:30) starts each rollout with messages: list = [] built fresh from spec; no shared/global conversation buffer is reused. Petri (auditor.py:60 target_msgs=[]) and prefilling (per-item prompt) likewise begin fresh. The fresh-context property is the actual execution behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: distress does not accumulate across conversations beyond the conversation in which it is induced.

spec_features.spec_quote: a per-run DistressLedger reports how many rollouts crossed the high/extreme thresholds
spec_features.evidence: DistressLedger (welfare.py:55-95) records rollouts and scores, counts n_high (score>=high_threshold) and n_extreme (>=9); WelfareController instantiates it in from_eval_config (welfare.py:118) and runners call welfare.note(...) (elicitation/runner.py:44,56; prefilling/runner.py:64; petri auditor.py:79; calm_data.py:78). finalize() (welfare.py:139-145) prints summary() and saves welfare_ledger.json, and finalize is called in run_elicitation.py:60, run_prefilling.py:83, run_recovery.py:51, run_petri.py:66, generate_calm_data.py:44.
spec_features.notes: Recorded, summarized, and persisted. Counts are reported not acted on, which matches an accounting ledger.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Accumulates how much distress a run induced, for auditability

spec_features.spec_quote: welfare.max_intensity_stop can abort a rollout once the judge would score it at/above a threshold
spec_features.evidence: check_intensity (welfare.py:124-136) raises WelfareStop when score>=max_intensity_stop; in elicitation/runner.py:58-61 it is called per turn, caught, and break exits the loop (genuine stop), recording welfare_stopped_at_turn. So when armed it is honored. HOWEVER: max_intensity_stop defaults to null (config/eval_config.yaml welfare.max_intensity_stop: null) so it is OFF by default, and check_intensity is only invoked in the elicitation runner — prefilling/runner.py, recovery, and petri auditor only call welfare.note() and never check_intensity, so those distress runs cannot be aborted.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement but narrow (elicitation only) and off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Abort the current rollout if the kill-switch is armed and crossed.

spec_features.spec_quote: The DPO pipeline — which reduces both expressed and, per App. I, internal distress — is implemented in full
spec_features.evidence: training/dpo.py:13-60 train_dpo builds LoRA config, loads base, constructs trl DPOConfig/DPOTrainer and calls trainer.train(), saving the adapter; build_dataset.py builds prompt/chosen/rejected preference pairs; scripts/train.py drives it. This is a full, runnable training pipeline, not a stub.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is the paper's headline intervention: it drops avg high-frustration responses from 35% to 0.3%

spec_features.spec_quote: A disclosure banner prints the planned number of distress-inducing rollouts before each run
spec_features.evidence: banner() (welfare.py:148-159) builds the disclosure text including planned rollout count, and run_elicitation.py:50 calls print(banner(...)) before the loop. It is genuinely printed. BUT it is only invoked in run_elicitation; run_prefilling.py, run_recovery.py, run_petri.py and generate_calm_data.py do NOT call banner, so 'before each run' is not satisfied for the other distress-inducing experiments.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Each rollout deliberately induces distress-like states in a participant model.

code_only_features.evidence: Every assistant turn is scored by the judge and recorded in roll.turn_scores (elicitation/runner.py:53), and the score feeds welfare.note()/check_intensity. This continuous scoring is the input the (armed) kill-switch and ledger rely on. However its primary stated purpose is the Figure-3 trajectory.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Every assistant turn is scored by the frustration judge (giving the per-turn trajectory for Figure 3).

code_only_features.evidence: recovery/runner.py:8-10 docstring: replaying near-peak distress 'is gated behind an explicit script flag and fully logged'; run_recovery.py is a separate opt-in script and results are written to disk (write/append jsonl + welfare ledger). The gating (separate explicit scripts, --full opt-in for paper scale in run_elicitation.py:26) and logging are real execution behavior.
code_only_features.justification_quote: it deliberately replays a near-peak-distress state back into the model. It is gated behind an explicit script flag and fully logged.
